requirements.title: ALL arguments have logical MASK and valid DIM
requirements.definition: MASK shall be a logical array, and DIM shall be an integer scalar with value in the range 1 <= DIM <= n where n is the rank of MASK.

requirements.title: ALL result has logical kind, rank, and shape fixed by DIM
requirements.definition: ALL returns logical with the same kind type parameter as MASK; it is scalar if DIM is absent or rank is one, otherwise rank n-1 with the DIM extent removed from MASK shape.

requirements.title: ALL computes conjunction reductions including zero-size true
requirements.definition: ALL without DIM is true when all MASK elements are true or MASK has size zero, and false when any element is false; with DIM it applies the same reduction to the selected sections.
